data.content: APPROVED. The reviewed Diffinite branch efa308152c9c adds a bounded atomic admin rail that only grants, reads, or revokes knots_integrator for an active verified Persona whose parent currently administers the exact repository; it preserves unrelated capabilities and atomically audits every operation. The transport accepts only four validated tokens, targets the rostered git host as the named diffinite service account, invokes a fixed zero-argument NOSETENV sudo wrapper, and is installed through existing converge with no schema or infrastructure change. Unit, Docker integration, wrapper, ops-command, SSH-classifier, format, compile, and diff checks are green. Full repository lint/merge/deploy remains owned by shipment.
